**Minecraft Gameplay Screen (First-Person View)**

*   **Title/Context:** In-game world view (Survival/Creative mode).
*   **Buttons/UI:**
    *   **Crosshair:** Center white plus sign (+) for aiming.
    *   **Hotbar:** Bottom row of 9 inventory slots (currently holding a block/item in the first slot).
    *   **Hand:** Visible player hand holding the selected item (bottom-left).
